prompts.commitPolicy: Scope every commit message to the queued slice. Production changes in Server, CLI, Tray, InstallerApp, Installers, or Desktop are customer-facing and should be fix or feat unless they are true no-behavior source refactors. Use test for test-only changes and PackageSmoke changes, unless they are queued with same-slice fix or feat production changes. Use refactor for internal no-behavior source changes. Use chore only for maintenance, packaging, CI, or tooling changes that do not affect customer runtime behavior.
